## Class 2 — one brand, one hex, two references

Needs eyes. Two threads sharing an RGB is normal **across** brands
(identity is `brandId:reference`; RGB is display-only — D55/D56).
Within a single brand it is likelier a transcription slip, but only
the owner can say. Rows marked **consecutive** pair adjacent
references — the shape a copied-down spreadsheet cell makes.
